guard: history clear refuses misleading channel selection, read filters and follow mode before a destructive whole-space purge
why: A fresh complete dependency build precedes these proofs. Every mutation changes only the CLI package and recompiles that package before the real binary runs; restoration rebuilds the same package.
Each native case first proves valid purge and both channel sentinels. Removing its guard must fail its named preservation assertion. The normal clear --dms path is exercised separately.

mutations.name: clear accepts an extra channel
mutations.find: if (rest.length) throw usage("history clear takes no channel; it clears every channel in the selected space");
mutations.expectRed: history clear refuses an extra channel before purging either channel
mutations.cell: history clear refuses an extra channel before purging either channel
